lines.trans: Soon I will become a real governor!
Of course you will, dear Pavel Yuryevich.
I am the most reliable partner in Moscow.
Pasha, you didn't even try the lasagna?
I decided to return home earlier.
And now I see you have guests.
Vika, wait, let's explain everything calmly.
Where is your conscience, Pasha?
Please don't be so very angry.
Hello, police? Someone broke into my home!
I'll give the address: seven Sadovaya Street.
Vika, I understand you are very upset.
I will definitely explain everything to you.
Most importantly remember that I love you!

meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

влезть.gloss: to climb in, break into, get into

meanings.en: to climb into, break into, enter secretly

examples.text: В мой дом влезли чужие люди!
Кот ловко влез на высокое дерево.
examples.trans: The cat deftly climbed up the tall tree.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.
The governor has come to the town.

meanings.en: to dictate, to read out (for someone to write down or dial)

examples.trans: The teacher is dictating a text.
There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: You didn't even try the lasagna?

examples.text: На ужин мы заказали горячую лазанью.
examples.trans: For dinner we ordered hot lasagna.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I'll definitely buy you a tank.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: partner, associate in business or activity

examples.trans: I am the most reliable partner.

examples.text: У него появился новый деловой партнёр.
examples.trans: He got a new business partner.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.en: a bit earlier, a little earlier

examples.trans: I decided to return home a bit earlier.
Let's wake up a bit earlier tomorrow.

examples.text: Вика, я понимаю, ты очень расстроена.
examples.trans: Vika, I understand you are very upset.
The bad news upset him greatly.
Sadovaya Street is located in the center.

examples.text: В саду стояла красивая садовая скамейка.
examples.trans: There was a pretty garden bench in the garden.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.en: to be angry, to be cross

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: имей совесть! = have a heart! / shame on you!
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
